## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-*juan* literary collection by **Zūnshì** 遵式 (964–1032) — the Tiāntái-Pure Land master of Hángzhōu Tiānzhúsì — re-edited (重編 *chóngbiān*) by the later monk **Huìguān** 慧觀. Companion to Zūnshì's *Tiānzhú biéjí* ([KR6d0227](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0227)); together the two works constitute Zūnshì's principal collected literary writings.

**Abstract**

The composition of the original Zūnshì material is bracketed within his productive period c. 996–1032; the editorial finalisation by Huìguān extends the bracket to the late Sòng / Yuán period (c. 1300).
